      "status_by_quote": "returning the state and not a bool at the `load()` function, is the better way to go imho :)"

    {
      "id": "c:5554537521",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "interface",
      "text": "Add @return documentation for Load() to clarify its return values and error behavior",

    },
    {
      "id": "rc:4281672916",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "safety",
      "text": "Removing ReadRequest and inlining into TryReadRequestInternal duplicates buffer cleanup across each catch block, risking cleanup omission when adding future error cases",
      "quote": "ReadRequest gave us one place to clean up `m_recv_buffer` after a failed parse. now, each `catch` block has to remember to do that itself, so it is easy for someone adding a new error case later to forget.",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author proposed an inner try/catch block to consolidate cleanup instead of restoring ReadRequest, waiting for winterrdog's response",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:4302740105"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:4302740105",
      "status_by_quote": "Could potentially add an inner `try`/`catch`-block... Would prefer doing that over bringing back `HTTPRemoteClient::ReadRequest()`. WDYT?"
    }

        "SetState()"
      ]

    {
      "on": "reviewer",
      "what": "winterrdog's feedback on author's proposed inner try-catch cleanup approach",
      "id": "rc:4302740105"
    }
